title: Model comparison showreel: 'Opus 5.5 Max' vs 'GPT 6 Astra Max' — chrome 3D + lime
summary: Two 15 s code-made motion reels back to back, each introduced by a model-name title card. The first (0-15 s) is a flat red/blue/white kinetic reel (bouncing ball, FRAME, CODE glitch, dot grid, 3D cube field, MOTION marquee, CLAUDE end card). The second (16-31 s) is the standout: near-black and acid-lime slides with heavy grotesk headlines on the left and a rotating chrome-and-lime 3D object on the right (knot, Möbius type ring, blob, star), framed by a thin editorial HUD.
fit_reason: The second half's layout (big two-line headline left, hero object right, mono meta lines, progress bar, slide counter 01-06) is a premium, repeatable SaaS launch template; swap the chrome toy for a product UI card and it works.

palette.mood: dark premium with acid-lime highlight (part 2); flat red/blue/white poster (part 1)

typography.display: tight heavy grotesk (Inter Display Black / Neue Haas Bold look), slightly negative tracking, full stops after headlines ('IT LOUD.', 'WITHOUT LIMITS.')
typography.size_behaviour: two-line headline ~12% of frame height, left-aligned in the left half; second line in accent colour
typography.notes: Line 1 in off-white, line 2 in lime (on dark) or black (on lime). Under it: two lines of monospace body ('15 SECONDS. / ZERO BORING FRAMES.'), a pill tag, a thin arrow ↗. HUD: top-left '/ PORTFOLIO' + section line '01 / AN IDEA THAT MOVES', top-right '16:9  01 — 06', bottom-left 'MAKE IT LOUD', bottom-right timecode, centre segmented progress dashes.

recreate.how: HTML+GSAP or Remotion for the layout, HUD, text slide-ins (translateX + blur filter + 2 ghost copies at lower opacity) and lime wipe. 3D objects: Three.js (MeshPhysicalMaterial metalness 1, roughness 0.1, HDRI env, lime emissive inner tube) or pre-rendered loops; for SaaSSuite swap the objects for floating product UI cards.
recreate.prompt: Dark premium launch slide system: near-black #0a0b08 background, two-line heavy grotesk headline left (line 1 off-white #eff1e5, line 2 acid lime #cbff27, ending with a full stop), a slowly rotating chrome object with lime glow on the right, mono body text and a pill tag below, thin editorial HUD with slide counter '01 — 06' and segmented progress bar. Headlines slide in from the left with motion blur and echo; a lime bar wipes between slides.
